تستقرئي (form X)
# تَسْتَقْرِئِي (tastaqriʔī) /tas.taq.ri.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# تُسْتَقْرَئِي (tustaqraʔī) /tus.taq.ra.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
